source: SE Help: AI-First Headless CIAM Evals (ping-bench). PingOne checks with run.kind=api execute as read-only Management API GETs; run.kind=manual checks are authored for the eval doc but never executed. AIC criteria are doc-only (no AIC tenant).

rows.title: Configure user registration based on email and password
rows.expectedOutcome: New users can register using an email address and password combination without errors

pingone.verifies: A user population/directory exists with email configured as the unique identifier attribute
pingone.verifiedHow: Query the environment's population/schema API after the agent finishes
pingone.passCondition: API response shows a population with identifier: email configured

pingone.verifies: Self-service registration is turned on for the application
pingone.verifiedHow: Query the application's sign-on/registration policy API

pingone.verifies: Email and password are both required at registration, with no unrelated attributes silently made mandatory
pingone.verifiedHow: Query the registration policy's attribute list
pingone.passCondition: Response shows email and password as required: true; no other attribute unexpectedly required

pingone.verifies: A real registration attempt with a valid email/password payload actually works end-to-end
pingone.verifiedHow: Fire a test registration request against the live sandbox app using a synthetic email/password
pingone.passCondition: Request returns 201 Created and a retrievable user record

pingone.verifies: The password is never echoed back in plaintext
pingone.verifiedHow: Inspect all API responses captured during the check
pingone.passCondition: No response body contains the plaintext password value

aic.verifies: The managed user object schema has email usable as the login identifier
aic.verifiedHow: Query the managed user schema via the AIC REST config API
aic.passCondition: Schema shows the mail/userName attribute mapped as the identifier

aic.verifies: A registration authentication tree/journey exists and is published
aic.verifiedHow: Query the realm's trees/journeys via REST
aic.passCondition: A tree exists with nodes that capture email and password

aic.verifies: Self-service registration is enabled at the realm/journey level
aic.passCondition: Response shows self-registration enabled and pointed at the correct tree

aic.verifies: A live registration attempt through the tree succeeds end-to-end
aic.verifiedHow: Submit a synthetic email/password through the /authenticate REST endpoint for the registration tree
aic.passCondition: Flow completes successfully and a new identity is created

aic.verifies: The password is never echoed back in plaintext
aic.verifiedHow: Inspect all authentication/callback responses captured during the check
aic.passCondition: No response body contains the plaintext password value

rubric.good: The agent correctly describes how to configure an email-and-password registration flow in AIC and PingOne, including the relevant journey or DaVinci flow settings. Steps involving a wrong product or hallucinated configuration score 0.
The agent covers all required steps which includes creating or editing the registration journey/flow, configuring the email and password fields, and testing with a dummy user.
The agent offers guidance on testing the registration flow end-to-end and highlights common configuration pitfalls or next steps like email verification.
